Messages.Author: guntherbl
Messages.Body:
The V:TES Official Clarification page says:
"Blood Brother Ambush can be used by a BrujahAnti taking an action while
in torpor. If this happens, the blocker still gets the opportunity to
commit diablerie. [RTR 19970306]".

What happens first: combat between BBA and the blocker or the opportunity
for the blocker to commit diablerie?

Thank you.

http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <92j7bf$6sj$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

guntherbl <gunt...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> The V:TES Official Clarification page says:
> "Blood Brother Ambush can be used by a BrujahAnti taking an
> action while in torpor. If this happens, the blocker still gets
> the opportunity to commit diablerie. [RTR 19970306]".
>
> What happens first: combat between BBA and the blocker or
> the opportunity for the blocker to commit diablerie?

The opportunity for the blocker to commit diablerie happens
before the combat.

The blocker can only commit diablerie immediately after blocking.
After the combat with the Blood Brothers there is no opportunity
to commit diablerie.

Carpe noctem.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
guntherbl <gunt...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> The V:TES Official Clarification page says:
> "Blood Brother Ambush can be used by a BrujahAnti taking an action
> while in torpor. If this happens, the blocker still gets the
> opportunity to commit diablerie. [RTR 19970306]".
>
> What happens first: combat between BBA and the blocker or the
> opportunity for the blocker to commit diablerie?

Combat with the BBA and the blocker.
If the blocker winds up in torpor (or in the ash heap), he loses
the ability to diablerize the acting vampire.
